source: Orion cartel territories (G15.44) — cartel Home Territory + Operating Zone, provided by user 2026-08-01.
note: A cartel has UNLIMITED access to option weapons produced in its Home empire; up to 20% of the fleet's option mounts may draw from Operating-Zone empires; up to 10% from any other (Outside) empire. Empire names are canonical: Federation, Klingon, Kzinti, Lyran, LDR, Hydran, Romulan, Gorn, ISC, WYN. NOTE: 'Dragon' is listed with Operating Zone = Federation (same as its Home) — flagged for confirmation; as written it simply has no operating zone beyond its home.
